subject: Inbound: Private/VPC demo scheduling with FinReg - Olivia Park
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@finreg.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — Private/VPC deployment (SOC2 scope)

Hi Marissa,

We signed up via the self-serve trial and we're evaluating Redwood for a Private/VPC/on-prem option for regulated workloads. I'm leading the evaluation for FinReg Solutions (we're a mid-sized financial services compliance platform).

High-level asks:
- We need a demo focused on Private/VPC deployment architecture, key controls (KMS/HSM integration), and how audit logs & retention work.
- Confirm whether Redwood can run air-gapped on-prem installs and what the deployment constraints are.
- Walk us through SOC 2 evidence & any security questionnaires you can provide.

I attached our SOC2 questionnaire (FinReg-SOC2-questions.pdf) — it's long but should help guide the conversation. Our ideal timeline is a demo next week (10/5–10/9). Our timezone is PT.

Attendees: Myself (Head of Cloud Platforms), our InfoSec lead (Tariq Ahmed), and procurement (copied on procurement@finreg.com).

Can you confirm availability and a short agenda? Also please include any pre-demo checklist so we can prepare network contacts for IP allowlisting if needed.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Cloud Platforms
FinReg Solutions
olivia.park@finreg.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@finreg.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — Private/VPC deployment (SOC2 scope)

Hi Olivia — thanks for the detailed note and for uploading the SOC2 questionnaire. Great fit for the team to review.

Quick replies to your asks:
- We can demo Private/VPC and our on-prem option; most of the controlled items you listed (KMS, audit logs, retention, and evidence exports) are covered in our Private offering. We'll tailor the demo to SOC 2-relevant flows.
- On air-gapped installs: we have a supported on-prem package for regulated customers — we'll cover deployment constraints and what we ship vs. what you manage.
- I've attached a short pre-demo checklist and a calendar invitation stub (demo-portal-invite.ics). Please review and let us know network contacts for allowlisting.

Proposed times (all PT):
- Tue 10/6 11:00–11:45am PT
- Thu 10/8 10:00–10:45am PT
- Thu 10/8 2:00–2:45pm PT

Neha (cc'd) will own scheduling and calendar invites. Rishi is our sales lead and will join the demo for procurement/security items.

Suggested agenda (30–40 min):
1) Intros & goals (5 min)
2) Architecture walkthrough: Private vs. on-prem differences (10 min)
3) Security controls: KMS/HSM, audit logs, key retention, evidence exports (10 min)
4) Q&A and next steps (10–15 min)

If any of the proposed slots work, Neha will send an invite. If you prefer a separate technical deep-dive with our infra engineer, we can schedule a follow-up.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@finreg.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirming demo — Thu 10/8 10:00am PT

Hi Olivia / team — Neha here (SDR at Redwood). Thanks for the quick turnaround. Olivia, we can confirm the Thu 10/8 10:00–10:45am PT slot and I just sent a calendar invite (attached: demo-portal-invite.ics). Please accept when you have a moment.

Pre-demo asks so we can prepare:
- Final attendee list + roles (we need at least one technical contact for network allowlist)
- Any specific SOC 2 items you want us to demonstrate (e.g., evidence export, retention policy screenshots)
- If you want an NDA in advance or a PO template, let us know and I'll route to Rishi.

Network allowlist: we'll need the IP ranges for your proxy/firewall or the contact who can set allowlist rules. If you prefer, upload the SOC2 questionnaire answers to this shared drive link so our team can pre-read: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/finreg-pre-demo-checklist

Attachments: demo-portal-invite.ics (calendar invite stub)

Thanks — I'll follow up with a calendar invite reminder 24 hours before.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sales Development Representative, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Thanks Neha — we've accepted the invite for Thu 10/8 10:00am PT.

Attendees (confirmed):
- Olivia Park (Head of Cloud Platforms) — olivia.park@finreg.com
- Tariq Ahmed (InfoSec lead) — tariq.ahmed@finreg.com
- Priya Natarajan (Engineering manager) — priya.natarajan@finreg.com (attending for deployment constraints)

Looking forward to the demo.

Best,
Olivia
